verdict.rationale:
dlt provides a documented CLI (`dlt init`, pipeline scaffolding) and Python API (`pipeline.run`) for headless pipeline creation, plus a dedicated dltHub AI Harness with skills/rules/MCP servers specifically designed to let coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) build, deploy, and run production pipelines end-to-end, backed by an official MCP server and OpenAPI-based pipeline generator for scaffolding from specs. Deployment is confirmed headless-capable (GitHub Actions, Airflow, serverless, `dlthub deploy`).

missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence (outside vendor docs) that an agent successfully scaffolds+runs a pipeline end-to-end, and clearer detail on non-interactive/headless CLI flags for full automation.
